patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient's family reports a gradual change in behavior starting a few months ago, which includes inappropriate laughing, using foul language, and occasionally grabbing people without warning. Recently, the patient's memory has also notably deteriorated, leading to difficulty in caring for himself.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Change in behavior including inappropriate actions
Secondary_Symptoms: Trouble taking care of personal needs

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: No significant past medical or psychiatric history. No history of alcohol or substance abuse.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Recently retired, lives with a spouse. Non-smoker, drinks alcohol socially. No history of legal or financial issues.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies headache, visual changes, seizures, muscle weakness, or other neurological symptoms.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with changes in behavior and memory over the past few months.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what’s been going on? Patient: I’ve had increasing trouble with how I act around people, and my memory has been getting worse over the past few months. My spouse has noticed I sometimes laugh or speak inappropriately, and I’ve had moments where I grab at people unexpectedly.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any joint swelling or pain. It’s mainly been changes in how I behave with others and getting worse memory and trouble managing my daily self-care.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or discomfort in your skin lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any itching or unusual skin discomfort. It’s mostly been the behavioral changes and my memory worsening, plus trouble keeping up with personal care day to day.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “I can lift my arms above my head without any trouble, and I haven’t noticed weakness or changes in how my arms feel.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any vision loss or changes recently—there’s been no pain with anything vision-related.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s been so high it feels like you’re burning up—something above 104°F (40°C) that makes you feel extremely hot or dizzy?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any fever like that, and I don’t feel burning up or extremely dizzy. It’s mainly the worsening memory and inappropriate behavior that’s been happening over the past few months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “I wouldn’t say I’ve been unusually stressed or overwhelmed—I’ve mostly just noticed the behavior changes and my memory getting worse. My spouse says it’s been noticeable over the past few months, especially with how I act around people.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any burning or discomfort when I urinate. It’s mainly been my memory getting worse and my behavior around people changing over the past few months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had chills or felt feverish—if anything, it’s been more like my behavior has been changing and my memory keeps worsening over the past few months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breasts that feel fixed or don’t move?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses anywhere like that, and I don’t have breast changes or anything fixed that doesn’t move. It’s been mainly the worsening memory and the inappropriate behavior toward people over the last few months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling any pain or discomfort on the side of your back or abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any pain or discomfort on my back or abdomen between my ribs and hips. It’s mainly been the changes in how I act around people and my memory getting worse, along with trouble managing my day-to-day self-care.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel pain in your calf when you walk, and does that pain go away when you stop walking?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have calf pain when I walk—nothing like that, and it doesn’t seem to come and go with stopping. It’s mainly the worsening memory, trouble with daily self-care, and inappropriate behavior like laughing or grabbing people unexpectedly.”
